defect: `Majlis Agama Islam Negeri Pulau Pinang` is not emitted.  The page prints two rows, each numbered `1.`, under two different opinion captions.
diagnosis: The second caption is typeset with wide inter-word gaps and wraps (`PENDAPAT TANPA   TEGURAN   DENGAN   PERENGGAN PENEGASAN PERKARA DAN PERENGGAN` / `HAL-HAL LAIN`), so its tail is not recognised as a heading and the two `1.` anchors collapse into one row.
why_unfixed: Recognising a heading that wraps across two lines needs the caption matcher to join header lines before testing, which risks swallowing genuine agency rows printed in capitals; not attempted without a verified sweep.
impact_on_data: One agency is missing from the FY2021 sijil register for Pulau Pinang.  The surviving row is correct.

affected_rows: unknown - a latent tokeniser defect, not a located row set
defect: A figure printed EXACTLY ONE SPACE after the previous figure is dropped by `lkan_state_parser._value_tokens`.
diagnosis: `_NUM_RE` allows one optional space after the sign, so when two figures are one space apart the scanner starts the second match ON that space; its preceding character is then the last digit of the first figure and the date / section-number guard discards it.  Seen on Sarawak CMD.43.2018 J4.14, where every row lost `27.5 25.8 35.2`.
why_unfixed: The root fix (trim leading white space before applying the guard) was implemented and DELIBERATELY REVERTED: it moved roughly 2,000 rows across all 13 states, raised the refusal count, and degraded the frozen Selangor regression.  It needs its own pass with the column clustering retuned alongside it.
impact_on_data: Mostly percentage and PERUBAHAN columns, which are not extracted anyway.  Where it hits a money column the row is marked `column_geometry=incomplete_row`, so no figure is wrong - some are absent.
